title: Traditional German Sausage and Rice Bowl
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring German sausage and flavorful rice. Perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: quirky sausage (Frankfurter)
ingredients.notes: you can use any brand of your choice

ingredients.name: arroz (Spanish rice)
ingredients.notes: Spanish rice is a good choice here

ingredients.name: negro (black pepper)
ingredients.notes: add as much as you like

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: add as much as you like

ingredients.name: beer (optional)
ingredients.notes: add a splash for extra flavor

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the quirky sausage and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the Spanish rice and stir to combine with the sausage and vegetables.
Add the black pepper, salt, and beer (if using) and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and serve hot.
Serve with additional beer on the side (optional)
